pads.file: 02_人体骨骼晶格肌肉方案/输出/channel_first/unified_SC_AC/passive_pad_engagement_paths.json

scope: The existing three 12 mm candidate pads are modeled as unilateral normal springs. Contact requires positive compression inside the fixed rib patch perimeter, with no bottoming. Reuses the nominal gravity load and eight tension-only paths at 30 N per wire. This prescribed-pose calculation does not integrate motion, prove stable contact, validate pad material, or include TPU or cuff loading. The added long-travel fit tests one preload per existing pad across all poses, assuming the spring can physically provide the required travel. The ideal independent pad forces are uncapped to bound the benefit of the existing contact directions.
